nodes.description: Contract owner address; grants privileged access to delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and the whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Whitelist mapping checked by ensure to bypass the sale condition.
Minimum sale amount used by condition and configured by init.
Maximum sale amount used by condition and configured by init.
Sale count limit read by condition and configured by init.
Whitelisted trade address read by ensure and written by setTradeAddress.
Hardcoded Uniswap router constant address used in the ensure whitelist.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant token decimals (18) used to scale supply and sale limits.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist/sale gate; returns true for owner, UNI, tradeAddress, pair or canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance and balance arithmetic without SafeMath, then ensure() check.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly with no validation.
Internal view enforcing sale number, minimum and maximum sale limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker/allowed address and calldata.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked multiplications.
Owner-only batch transfer loop with unchecked multiplication and loop index.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation using CREATE2 keccak hashing.
Payable constructor minting supply to msg.sender and setting unlimited UNI allowance.
msg.sender - externally controlled caller address used for ownership, allowance and balance authorization.
Low-level delegatecall executed on a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**decimals) in init.

edges.reason: _to parameter is forwarded from transfer() into transferFrom().
_value parameter is forwarded from transfer() into transferFrom().
transfer() uses msg.sender as the _from address, letting the caller move their own tokens.
transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value) and returns its result.
ensure() evaluates the _from parameter against the whitelist addresses.
ensure() passes _value into condition() for limit validation.
_from parameter drives allowance, ensure and balanceOf checks in transferFrom().
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom().
_value parameter drives all arithmetic in transferFrom().
transferFrom() compares msg.sender with _from to decide whether allowance must be consumed.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
allowance is reduced with an unchecked subtraction inside transferFrom().
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
balanceOf[_from] is decremented with an unchecked subtraction (integer underflow risk).
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each successful transfer.
ensure() grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals the owner.
ensure() reads tradeAddress for the whitelist comparison.
ensure() reads the constant UNI router address for the whitelist comparison.
ensure() grants a bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) when the caller is not whitelisted.
ensure() uses the local _UNI pair address in the whitelist comparison.
ensure() calls pairFor(factory, WETH, address(this)) to compute the whitelisted pair.
pairFor() return value is stored in the local _UNI variable.
The computed _UNI value flows back into the ensure() whitelist condition.
condition() uses _from to read _onSaleNum[_from].
condition() compares _value against _minSale and _maxSale.
condition() reads _minSale to reject transfers below the configured minimum.
condition() reads _maxSale to reject transfers above the configured maximum.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary calldata.
Parameter a becomes the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b becomes the delegatecall payload.
delegate() executes caller-supplied calldata in the contract storage context, allowing storage hijack and reentrant state manipulation.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale limits.
Parameter saleNum is assigned to _saleNum.
Parameter token is scaled into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken is scaled into _maxSale.
init() performs unchecked token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) multiplications.
init() writes the unchecked _minSale value.
init() writes the unchecked _maxSale value.
init() writes _saleNum, controlling subsequent condition() behaviour.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers.
Recipient array _tos drives the batchSend() loop.
Per-recipient _value drives the total and the balance increments.
total = _value * _tos.length is computed without overflow protection.
batchSend() subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] inside the batch operation.
Each iteration extracts _to = _tos[i].
batchSend() credits balanceOf[_to] and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
Loop index i controls the batchSend() iteration bound.
The extracted recipient _to receives the credited balance.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
Parameter addr is written into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress() updates the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
pairFor() hashes the factory parameter into the pair address.
tokenA participates in the token0/token1 ordering and hash.
tokenB participates in the token0/token1 ordering and hash.
pairFor() assigns token0 from the sorted token pair.
pairFor() assigns token1 from the sorted token pair.
pairFor() computes the final CREATE2 pair address.
Constructor parameter _name sets the token name.
Constructor parameter _symbol sets the token symbol.
Constructor parameter _supply sets totalSupply and the initial balance.
Constructor assigns owner and initial balance to msg.sender.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, the root of all privileged checks.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply*(10**decimals).
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as owner.
Parameter _spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve().
Parameter _value is stored as the raw allowance in approve().
approve() mutates the allowance state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only exists to feed transfer(), it can be folded into the function signature.
Parameter _value only exists to feed transfer(), it can be folded into the function signature.
Parameter _from is only used by the ensure() whitelist check.
Parameter _value is only forwarded by ensure() into condition().
Parameter _from is only used inside transferFrom() arithmetic and checks.
Parameter _to is only used inside transferFrom() balance updates.
Parameter _value is only used inside transferFrom() arithmetic.
Parameter _spender is only used as the allowance mapping key in approve().
Parameter _value is only stored by approve().
Parameter _from only indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
Parameter _value is only compared with the sale limits inside condition().
Parameter a is the direct target of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter b is the direct calldata payload of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by init().
Parameter token is the operand of the unchecked multiplication producing _minSale.
Parameter maxToken is the operand of the unchecked multiplication producing _maxSale.
Parameter _tos only drives the batchSend() loop length and recipients.
Parameter _value is only used in batchSend() amount arithmetic.
Parameter addr is only written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Parameter factory is only hashed inside pairFor().
Parameter tokenA is only used in the pairFor() sorting hash.
Parameter tokenB is only used in the pairFor() sorting hash.
Parameter _name is only stored as the token name in the constructor.
Parameter _symbol is only stored as the token symbol in the constructor.
Parameter _supply is only used to mint the initial supply in the constructor.
Local _UNI has no meaning outside the ensure() whitelist comparison.
Local total exists solely to compute the unchecked balance subtraction in batchSend().
Loop index i is an implementation detail of the batchSend() iteration.
Local _to is just the loop-local recipient inside batchSend().
Local token0 is a temporary sorting variable inside pairFor().
Local token1 is a temporary sorting variable inside pairFor().
Local pair is the return value of pairFor() and can be inlined into the caller.
